extras.verified_at_basis: checked against the live service on 2026-11-09
extras.quota_verbatim: 5 GB OneDrive-backed file storage per user, BUT images and videos uploaded via Gallery/Media are explicitly NOT stored in OneDrive and have no storage limit
extras.limits_verbatim: 250 GB max per individual file in OneDrive (personal); 100 MB per file in the Teams channel Files UI; media path takes images/video only, no arbitrary binaries; chat history limits are separate from file limits
extras.egress_verbatim: Free; media served from Microsoft's CDN, chat-attached files via OneDrive share links
extras.chaining_verbatim: 5 GB x unlimited free Microsoft accounts (OneDrive-backed); separately the media path is per-record unlimited - 'share as many photos and videos as you want' - which is the interesting half: an image/video album with no byte cap, multiplied by unlimited free accounts.
extras.tooling_verbatim: No public Teams-free file API; attachments land in OneDrive, so Graph API against the backing OneDrive is the usable path. Wrapper-only for the media path.
extras.agent_focus: Team collaboration suites: Slack free (files, retention), Microsoft Teams, Mattermost, Rocket.Chat, Zulip, Twist, Discourse, Basecamp, ClickUp, Notion, Coda, Airtable attachments

binding_note: the per-object cap sets the shard size and therefore the object count; it bounds the total more tightly than any headline quota
